olivia: quick thread 1: decision on prefetch/pagination defaults across SDKs (py/ts/go). server-owned prefetch vs client-owned? short pros/cons.
mike: currently both sides prefetch in places -> occasional doubled requests and weird throttling.
sara: hosted = server-owned by default. easier global limits and telemetry; SDKs get opt-out.
raj: private/dedicated customers prefer client defaults. server default can be surprising on-prem.
olivia: idea: keep a single SDK surface with `prefetch.mode = "auto"` where auto resolves to server for hosted and client for private/dedicated.
casey: API sketch (same across langs):
```
client = RedwoodClient({ prefetch: { mode: "auto", window_tokens: 128 } })
```
mike: two questions: who handles prefetch backoff/retry? and how do we avoid double-prefetch when old SDKs hit new servers?
sara: whoever issues the prefetch handles backoff. server should advertise capability header like `x-rw-prefetch: handled=v1` so SDKs can skip local prefetch when present (versioned handshake).
raj: transport tradeoff: default to a unary header handshake; provide optional control stream for long-lived sessions so server can push `prefetch_adjust` events. streaming is opt-in via `Session` object.
casey: sample surface: python `session = client.open_session({prefetchStream:true})` | ts similar.
mike: billing note: speculative prefetch tokens should be billable only if consumed by the model. add telemetry labels `prefetch_mode`, `prefetch_speculative`. keep conservative default window=128 to limit waste.
raj: long-term: unify prefetch + kv-cache into a single client cache/policy module so strategies are swappable. add to Q3 roadmap.
olivia: decision summary: hosted -> server-owned default; private/dedicated -> client default; SDKs expose `prefetch.mode` with `auto|server|client|off`; server advertises header `x-rw-prefetch`; unary headers by default + optional Session control stream; default window_tokens=128; telemetry + e2e tests for old-sdk fallbacks.
casey: i'll open a short RFC PR with API examples, header names, handshake flow, and migration notes.
mp-dev-bot: deploy-bot created issue INFR-2560: "prefetch ownership + sdk handshake" assigned to @casey.
olivia: thanks all, tagging followups: @sara telemetry, @raj proto, @mike e2e tests. closing thread for now. :rocket:
